reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Happy Pets Pantry is genuinely one of my favourite places, and if you asked my cockapoo, Clark, he’d probably tell you it’s his absolute favourite! 😂

We live in the neighborhood, so stopping by has practically become part of our daily routine. In fact, Clark refuses to walk past without stopping, looking at me, and doing his very best to convince me that we absolutely MUST go inside!

Sam and Sonia are such wonderful people, and their adorable little Charlie makes the place even more special. They’re incredibly welcoming, kind, and genuinely passionate about animals.

What I particularly appreciate is how knowledgeable they are. Sonia is an absolute gem! She always has thoughtful, practical suggestions and is more than happy to share her knowledge, whether it’s about pet care, grooming needs, or finding something suitable for Clark. You can tell that she genuinely cares about the animals and isn’t just interested in making a sale.

It’s rare to find a business where you feel so comfortable dropping by, asking questions, and having a lovely conversation. Sam and Sonia have created exactly that kind of environment.

I’m so grateful to have them so close to us, although my wallet might occasionally disagree with Clark’s enthusiasm! 😂❤️

Wonderful people, a welcoming atmosphere, and genuinely caring service. Couldn’t recommend them enough! 🐾
Gave me great advice re dog food for Shihpoo with food sensitivity! It's working beautifully.  Four years trying to figure this out. Grateful!

Great pet store with wonderful staff. I take my dog Charlie here for nail trims and he is always very well taken care of. The store owners are lovely and very knowledgeable in their products, always very helpful and just a pleasure to interact with. I highly recommend checking this place out. They have everything you need for your fur babies.
Great selection, fantastic location, wonderful staff!
Amazing place to get pet supplies especially for your doggies so much raw selection

They’re very knowledgeable about the pet food, I ask them lots of questions and they clarify everything and answer questions easily, I appreciate how they also ask you questions about your pets. It was always welcoming atmosphere , I love going here to get some dog food all the time.

Sonya and the team are truly incredible. They are so knowledgeable and friendly to my fur baby and myself. Our favorite shop!
Thank you for all that you do!
We (and our dogs) love this pet store! So well stocked and run by some of the nicest owners you could ever imagine!
Great  place -  friendly and knowledgeable  owners , very high quality  products 👌 …

A true hidden gem in the city. This pet store has a wide variety of excellent food an treats aswell many toys. If u haven't checked it out yet its a must. Prices are great an staff are outgoing, friendly, ready to help. I always feel good about my purchases.

PLATINUM RECOMMENDED!!  I’m a dog Dad; Pop the Chihuahua and I are BFFs through and through. I adopted him in April 2024, and to our blessed fortune, Happy Pets Pantry moved in 2 months later!

Sam, Sonia and Charlie the Maltese have become like family, anticipating our every move down to the detail! And to me, details matter a ton; in fact, I ledger all my pet stuff, and in 20 months, we’ve visited 38 times.

Pop and I have tried many Pet Stores around (as they seem to jump up like dandelions), but Happy Pets Pantry is THE ROSE! They’re always expanding inventory, accommodating new clients, growing the business to include grooming services and are always Happy! - Trust me, it’s not a tag or sales line; I really do feel happy relying on them!

20/10, for 200% and awesome customer service every single time!!

The owners are so knowledgeable and friendly. They genuinely care about you & your pet. I love the selection of cat products they have. The random free goodies seals the deal for me. Highly recommended & def returning !

HappyPets Pantry fantastic. The owners and staff go above and beyond, even offering to make home deliveries when a shipment arrives. If they don't have something in stock, they'll order it and get it in quickly, and there's a wide selection of goods in-store. Highly recommend. I don't review often but really wanted to give this store a shout-out.

Great selection - thrilled that I never have to worry that my dogs' specialty food is always in stock when I need it. The staff are friendly, greet me by name, and always have a treat ready for my dogs :)

New Pet Shop for our St. Jamestown area. Lots to choose from for your furbabies to eat, sleep and play. Lots of great brands on the shelf. Super lovely people who will help bring in special items and or flavours for your Babies.... if they can.
Wheelchair accessible and well needed in this section of the city, super handy.  Stop by and check them out.

I am thrilled that Happy Pets Pantry opened in our neighborhood.  They are so kind and thoughtful, always offering help and answering any questions we have.  They always ask how our cats are doing, remember us and are generous.  We recommend the shop to everyone we know.
Friendly and accommodating owners, help with finding the right products for your pets.

Lovely service at HappyPets Pantry!
The team was incredibly kind during my dog’s grooming. When I came back a few minutes later to request a bit more trimming around her face, they were very accommodating and friendly. Truly appreciate their care and willingness to help, highly recommend. Thank you for your excellent service!
Best pet shop in the area!! The staff is amazing and always so helpful with everything 🙌🏼🙌🏼 highly recommend …

Sonia is Awesome! She's Always so nice & helpful with whatever you need for your fur ball. The store is so well organized, plus they have Farmina bags & Acana wet cat food as well. So glad they're closeby.

I absolutely love Happy Pet Pantry! The team here is incredibly friendly and you can tell right away that they’re true dog lovers. They take such good care of my pup and the grooming service is always top-notch — my dog comes home looking and feeling amazing every single time! It’s such a joy to have a place like this right in our neighborhood. Highly recommend to anyone who wants their furry friend treated with love and care.
I love this place! Took my dog here for grooming and bought food.. the owner is super kind and attentive
Amazing experience. I love the attention and my dog was so happy. Definitely I will come back

Very satisfied pet mom! I brought my 3 year old Pomeranian for her grooming and we really loved the outcome. I liked how nice the people are and the location really is very convenient as I just live nearby. I dont have to go further just for my pet’s essential. My dog also loving her new bow tie from I believed the owner of the store 🫶🏻. We will def gonna come back.
Clementine Loves this place!
Small petshop with over average price stuff. Very friendly staff.

I love happy pets Pantry the owners are so welcoming  and the store is well stocked. My dogs love going there , they also has grooming services right now very convenient  and good prices , Claudia de groomer she is very nice and my doggies  love going there . Support small business 😍🐶 …
The best store ever! Fantastic atmosphere!
Favourite pet store! The owners are the sweetest :)

My little dogs love it here ! I have 3 Yorkies… Sonia thank you for always being so kind and helpful although I have moved and I don’t go as often anymore she still remembers me and treats me and my pups so well!
Amazing pet store with kind and knowledgeable staff. 10/10
Wide selection of food and treats. They even offer dog grooming at a reasonable price. Staff is also very friendly

I have been going here since they first opened and they have always provided amazing service. My dog has lots of allergies and can only eat duck meat, and sometimes they give free duck treats when I order food which is very nice. They are also very patient and helpful as well for example when my card doesn’t work or when I changed my order address.
I like this store! Very friendly and kind staff, always give samples and treats for my pets☺️
Great local pet shop, been coming since they opened and get all the raw food for my 2 cats.  Really friendly and helpful staff!
“ Best dog grooming in Downtown Toronto. HappyPets never disappoints. “

They carry a variety of items to keep our fur babies happy. My senior cat had to have a change of diet recently and they had what she needed. Very knowledgeable and friendly people, and a welcome addition to the neighbourhood.

All of their items' prices are competitive in comparison to other pet stores. Main advantage for me personally is that HappyPets has a very convenient location as it is just a minute away from home. They are very friendly and also knowledgable in terms of my kitten's food, treats, and her overall health. They also give out occasional food and treats as freebies, which I am grateful for.
Fantastic pet store and the owners are wonderful people!

I absolutely love having this pet store so close to my building! The staff are always incredibly friendly, knowledgeable, and helpful. They’ve consistently had the best prices for Farmina wet food, which I’ve been feeding my Bengal cat.

I have frequented this pet store for treats before and this time I wanted to check out the grooming services they just added … I was nervous at first to change my dogs groomer but Samantha made sure she discussed everything with me before and also kept me informed about my pup - this place is amazing in both service and grooming - check out my dogs picture
A very good pet shop.  The staff are friendly, knowledgeable, and experienced.  They also have a wide variety of products and very fresh kibble. Wet or dry and at a very fair price.

Always a positive experience shopping here! Sonia is super helpful and knowledgeable about product ingredients; you can tell she genuinely cares about your pet’s health! Appreciate the samples as well ❤️ Thank you!

I love going there, I always find something new and great for my dog. They are amazing with Boomer! they always spoiled my dog with treats haha and he is so excited every time we get in!
They have a large variety of dog treats, toys, cleaning products and food, they are 100% recommended!
Fair prices, friendly staff, knowledgeable and helpful.  Genuinely glad they've opened up shop.

Love to shop local and walk into a store that knows me, my pets and what they like! They are always happy to order special products for you or to help you find an alternative and they do not skip on the samples! Our cats love that they opened up so close to us 🥰🥰 …

I'm so happy that Pets Pantry opened, it's super accessible to me and the workers are always so lovely. Not expected, but the off chance you get extra goodies for your purchase - those little moments mean so much to me and my little guy! Thanks for having so many different options and brands and being a great addition to the community!
Really good customer service and wide range of selection!

I’m so happy we finally have such a great pet store in our neighbourhood! The selection here is amazing — they have everything you could possibly need for your furry companions. The owners themselves work in the store, and they’re incredibly kind, polite, and always happy to help if you’re unsure about what to choose.

When I couldn’t find a specific food my cats need, they went out of their way to order a big bag just for us — and that really touched me. It’s rare to find that level of care and personal attention. Highly recommend!

They're a convenient addition to the neighbourhood (the next closest pet store is a much longer walk for me and my senior dog). They're also generous with their treats and free samples. My dog liked one of the kibble samples so much, he's now eating unsoftened dry food again for the first time in years.

They have everything that you need. It's best to check their website because they actually let you know if a product is out of stock. My cat was shedding, and I needed a nice slicker brush urgently (I am a bit allergic to the hair flying everywhere, hahaha). I got the comb to collect the dead hair off the cat, and now my cat has a nice shiny coat! :)

Coming back again for my pet needs. Support local!
Wonderful place with wonderful owners! Always friendly and happy to help, and usually supply me with treats for my cat, even with the smallest purchase. Great local pet shop, 5 out of 5!

Local merchants not a chain!  Good people that care about you and your pets. Always helpful. Great selection for a wide range of pets. Prices are great too. I compare and Happy Pets is usually cheaper by a few dollars!!!! Sonya, Sam and Charlie are the best. Me and all my pets highly recommend you stop by-you will not be disappointed!!!
very friendly staff, they will advice what is best for your baby. whatever you need that they not have atm, they will even order for you just to statist your baby needs. my go to pet store!
Always friendly and helpful!

This is my trusted store to go to when I need to get my cats their royal canin dry food. I always trust that they will have the package that I need, and the person there is always so nice and friendly, and she so often gives free snacks as well!! Highly recommend this place to fill your pets' pantry!
Really friendly, helpful, and caring owners. Has a great selection of toys, treats, leashes, raw food, etc.

I am so lucky to have HappyPets Pantry close by! It is now my to go pets store where I can find the best food and healthy treats for my senior dogs and the owners are super friendly and always ready to answer your questions and give you knowledgeable advice. I will recommend it to friends! 🐶🐶 …

Happy Pets Pantry has been a great new addition to the neighborhood! Friendly and knowledgeable owners and a large variety of high-quality items you can't usually find in chain pet stores. My dog drags me in there every time we are walking past it.
Best Neighbourhood pet store..
Love this shop 100% recommend

My favourite pet store in the downtown core! Sonia and Sam are passionate about their knowledge and always recommend great options for my cat and dog. Very clean, aesthetically appealing and comfortable space. Shelves are always stocked with clean-ingredients lists; something I can feel good giving to my fur-babies. One of the main reasons I love HappyPets Pantry, is for their selection of exotics-something hard to come by in the city - a huge bonus! If you are lucky, you’ll get the meet Charlie, the loving store mascot (he’s got his own portrait behind cash!)

If I could give 6 stars I would . The lady is super friendly and really supportive. I always go there to buy my cat products she always make sure I get the best care and provide me more information and support me on getting  my cats diet healthy and nutritious would come back in a heart beat

Our favourite neighborhood pet store! Fully stocked with a wide variety of pet food, supplies and goodies to make our furry friends the happiest!! 😺🐶 Wonderful customer service and easy access 👍 Thank you for your kind attention 😺🐶💖 …
I absolutely love this pet store! They are incredibly friendly, knowledgeable and helpful. Would definitely recommend.

I recently discovered a new store and was helped by  Sonia, and I was very impressed! They have a fantastic variety of essential items, including quality dog food, treats, and accessories. When I visited to seek advice for my sick dog,  Sonia was incredibly kind and provided me with helpful feedback and product recommendations. Within two days, my puppy started to improve, and we were able to avoid a trip to the vet.

I love visiting the shop and chatting with Sonia! She is very sweet and always able to answer any questions about products. She also has provides lovely treats for my boy Sawyer even when he doesn’t accompany me in for a visit. I love to support local businesses and am glad this one is owned by great people!
Great store! The owners are very sweet and helpful! I go there all the time to get food and treats for my pets.
Not friendly
Best store!! So close! And very helpful! Always give me good advice!!

Amazing pet shop!! Sonia is always very friendly and knowledgeable about animals and pet products! I found a specific chicken heart treat at Happy Pets that my picky cat (she’s literally so picky) is obsessed with!! 100/10 would recommend!!!

I am sooo glad they opened up so close to my place. I always buy my cat food, treats and toys from there. The prices are are adorable, they have all the best brands, and the quality of the toys is amazing. The owners are also very friendly and knowledgeable. Must recommend!
It's always a blast to visit Happy Pets with my dog Winnie; the owners are always happy to see us and assist Winnie with all her treat needs.
Highly recommend !!!, very helpful stuff and great  selection of products.
My dog adores this pet store and both the owners are so kind and welcoming!
My dog's favourite place in the whole world.

Lovely couple owns and operates this local business great selection of high quality food and they will order things if you request with no extra cost. They also have raw food and deliver in the area. Very close to my home love popping into the shop with my pup
I recently started shopping here, the prices are fair and the staff is extremely friendly. This is my new spot for doggos needs
Relatively new to the neighbourhood. They are always lovely and have anything you could need for your pets. Highly recommend!
Great selection but the hours aren’t accommodating. They’re closed by 7pm ..
Very nice place lovely people my dogs love this place they get treated well and spoiled

“Best pet store ever! They have a great selection and are always fully stocked. The prices are amazing, which really helps with savings since I have two cats. The staff is always helpful and kind!!” Highly recommended one stop needs for yours pets
Very humble and professional staff and very clean store and my only place to go for my pets please do visit them highly recommended ⭐️5

This store is not a store you want to go to, the staff are unprofessional, vulgar, disrespectful, and extremely rude. They hung up on me several times when I was just asking if the owner of the store would be there. I highly recommend not attending this store if you don't want to go through that experience.
Good price

This is a lovely place, highly recommend it. The girl at the front desk was super helpful as I was trying to find the right wet food for my picky cat. She was very friendly, and the store carries a lot of great natural and healthy foods. The prices are reasonable considering the quality of products. It’s a small new business right between a Freshco and Shoppers, so I would love to keep shopping there and supporting local shops who actually care about pets and their owners. If you shop at any of the other stores, I would recommend talking to the staff as I’m sure they can find, if not the same product, something even better.
I love this store, they have a huge selection of items and the owners are super nice and welcoming

I recently started shopping at Happypets Pantry and I am very pleased with their online service. My dog food got delivered the next day. Also amazing selection of dog food, treats and bones at great price!
very friendly, willing to go the extra mile to provide great service, even for special requests
Awesome service and flexible prices
